## Specific task description

Task instruction: Lift two the white shoe with tongue logo, tips pointing left, into the medium cardboard shoe-box.

Task description: Put the two white shoes with logo-bearing tongues, one on each side of the view, into the open medium cardboard shoe box at the front center. Arrange the shoes one behind the other, with both toes pointing toward the left side of the image.

Success criteria: Place the white shoe on the left of the image in the front-central box region (toward the image bottom), and the right white shoe in the rear-central region (toward the top). Both must lie flat on the box bottom, soles down, openings up and toes left in the image, with both grippers open and releasing them.

## Execution tips

- Consider grasping straight areas on both sides of the middle-rear shoe body near the upper sole edge, closing effectively across its width. Avoid laces, tongue, and rounded toe to reduce slipping or an off-center grasp.
- The right white shoe partly extends beyond the initial image. Use live views to confirm both side edges and approach clearance, adjust the opening to shoe width at the grasp, and verify the fingers truly surround it before closing rather than merely overlap it in the image.
- When turning the shoe toe, leave rotation space where the sole is above the box rim and away from the red can behind it. Avoid sweeping the toe or heel into the box wall or clutter.
- The box interior is limited. Approach each shoe separately at its own front-back target and leave clearance for the shoe sides, box walls, and gripper, reducing disturbance to the other shoe or interference between grippers.
- Release only after the shoe sole is supported by the box bottom, then withdraw without squeezing the upper to avoid dropping the shoe, leaving it on the rim, or shifting it with the gripper.
